title: Lightly Spiced Venezuelan Chicken Hash
description: A spicy, springy Venezuelan dish featuring chopped onion, nimono-simmer, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a quick fix.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, and paprika to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the African bird's eye pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked white rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion mixture.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the rice mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the chicken hash hot, garnished with scallions.
